sources.snippet: Primary intended uses The primary intended users of these models are AI researchers. We primarily imagine the model will be used by researchers to better understand robustness, generalization, and other capabilities, biases, and constraints of computer vision models.

sources.title: What is clip-vit-base-patch32 and why do developers use it?
sources.snippet: clip-vit-base-patch32 is a pretrained multimodal embedding model that converts images and text into vectors within the same numerical space, allowing them to be directly compared using similarity metrics.
